title: President: two-party margin by precinct, Boone County
caption: Source: Boone County Clerk precinct results (Results_Long), github.com/olivergollapudi/boone-county-indiana-election-data. Elections: 2012 general, 2016 general, 2020 general, 2024 general. Method: Margin = (Republican − Democratic) ÷ (Republican + Democratic) votes. Each precinct colored by its own reported result. Caveat: 2012, 2016 use precinct shapes assumed equal to 2020's; lines show today's Indiana House districts; 2008 omitted (scanned data under review).

title: President: every precinct's two-party margin, 2012 → 2024 (grouped by today's Indiana House district)
caption: Source: Boone County Clerk precinct results (Results_Long), github.com/olivergollapudi/boone-county-indiana-election-data. Elections: 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024 general. Method: Margin = (Republican − Democratic) ÷ (Republican + Democratic) votes. Each panel: one precinct (H = today's Indiana House district); shaded red above the line = Republican margin, blue below = Democratic; scale ±80 points in every panel; text = total shift 2012→2024. Caveat: 2012 and 2016 precinct shapes assumed equal to today's (same 53 names).

title: Turnout by precinct, 2024 general (county: 65.7%)
caption: Source: Boone County Clerk precinct reports (Turnout_Long). Election: 2024 general. Method: ballots cast (public count) ÷ registered voters, as printed per precinct. Caveat: registered-voter counts are as printed in each precinct report, not adjusted in any way.

title: Statewide offices on the 2022 and 2026 ballots: two-party margin by today's district
caption: Source: Boone County Clerk results (Results_Long) and data/normalized/results_by_current_district.csv. Elections: 2022 and 2026 general. Method: Margin = (Republican − Democratic) ÷ (Republican + Democratic) votes. Both years are on today's precincts and district lines, so district figures are exact sums of whole precincts. Caveat: Boone County portion of each district only; the candidates differ between years. 2026 results are provisional (not yet certified).

title: President margin by Indiana House district: today's lines vs the lines at the time
caption: Source: data/normalized/results_by_current_district.csv and results_by_district_as_drawn.csv (Boone County Clerk results). Elections: 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024 general. Method: Margin = (Republican − Democratic) ÷ (Republican + Democratic) votes. Solid = precincts re-expressed on 2021-enacted lines; dashed = precincts in that district number at the time, read from each precinct's own ballot; dotted verticals mark new maps (dashed line breaks there); from 2022 the two coincide, so only earlier maps are drawn dashed; a single result under a map is not drawn. Caveat: Boone County portion only; a shared district number does not mean the same place.
